raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.25.8"
  python_min: "3.12"

package:
  name: mistral-vibe
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/mistralai/mistral-vibe/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: d042c88f6f533cd693080272c3357dcd73d095397208a95e0b9ea9a23d1f761a
    patches:
      - 0001-Relax-constraints-on-dependencies.patch
      # upstream builds with maturin to bundle the optional Rust harness; we ship pure Python
      - 0002-Build-pure-python-wheel-with-hatchling.patch
      # until is addressed https://github.com/conda-forge/mistral-vibe-feedstock/issues/74
      - 0003-Handle-optional-mistralai_vibe_local_harness-import.patch

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check
  noarch: python
  python:
    entry_points:
      - vibe = vibe.cli.launcher:main
      - vibe-acp = vibe.acp.entrypoint:main
      - vibe-app-server = vibe.app_server.stdio:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - agent-client-protocol ==0.11.0
